package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	cv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
	rv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/resource/v1"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/util"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
)

// Optional upstream execution, never a normal replay dependency. Keep raw
// autocomplete output separate from full original context of engine-selected IDs.
func TestPulseTraceDurations(t *testing.T) {
	dir := "/tmp/pulse-trace-durations"
	if e := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	id := func(n uint64, w int) []byte { b := make([]byte, w); binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(b[w-8:], n); return b }
	attr := func(k, v string) *cv.KeyValue {
		return &cv.KeyValue{Key: k, Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_StringValue{StringValue: v}}}
	}
	all := &tempopb.Trace{}
	rows := []*Trace{}
	durations := []uint64{0, 1, 9, 10, 99, 100, 999, 1000, 1001, 999999, 1000000, 1000001, 999999999, 1000000000, 1000000001, 9007199254740991, 9007199254740992, 9007199254740993, 9223372036854775806}
	for i := 0; i < 280; i++ {
		start := uint64(1)
		d := durations[i%len(durations)]
		tid := id(uint64(i+1), 16)
		label := "even"
		if i%2 == 1 {
			label = "odd"
		}
		owner := func(sid uint64, service string, begin, end uint64, parent []byte) *tv.ResourceSpans {
			return &tv.ResourceSpans{Resource: &rv.Resource{Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{attr("service.name", service)}}, ScopeSpans: []*tv.ScopeSpans{{Spans: []*tv.Span{{TraceId: tid, SpanId: id(sid, 8), ParentSpanId: parent, Name: service, StartTimeUnixNano: begin, EndTimeUnixNano: end, Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{attr("parity", label)}}}}}}
		}
		first := owner(1, "gateway", start, start+d/2, nil)
		second := owner(2, "worker", start+d/2, start+d, id(1, 8))
		if i == 0 {
			first.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].StartTimeUnixNano = 1_000_000_000
			first.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].EndTimeUnixNano = 1_000_000_001
			second.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].StartTimeUnixNano = 20_000_000_000
			second.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].EndTimeUnixNano = 20_000_000_100
		}
		// Rootless and multiple-root traces still have a complete retained envelope.
		if i%3 == 0 {
			first.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].ParentSpanId = id(99, 8)
		}
		if i%5 == 0 {
			second.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].ParentSpanId = nil
		}
		owners := []*tv.ResourceSpans{first, second}
		all.ResourceSpans = append(all.ResourceSpans, owners...)
		row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, tid, &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: owners}, nil)
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	wire, e := proto.Marshal(all)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(dir+"/input.protobuf", wire, 0644); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	formatCases := [][2]string{}
	spell := func(n uint64) { formatCases = append(formatCases, [2]string{fmt.Sprint(n), time.Duration(n).String()}) }
	for _, n := range append(durations, 9223372036854775807, 60000000000, 3600000000000, 3661000000001) {
		spell(n)
	}
	x := uint64(0x1a2b3c4d5e6f7788)
	for i := 0; i < 1024; i++ {
		x ^= x << 13
		x ^= x >> 7
		x ^= x << 17
		spell(x & 0x7fffffffffffffff)
	}
	formatBody, e := json.MarshalIndent(formatCases, "", "  ")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(dir+"/format-oracle.json", append(formatBody, '\n'), 0644); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
	opts := common.DefaultSearchOptions()
	engine := traceql.NewEngine()
	target := "trace:duration"
	tag, e := traceql.ParseIdentifier(target)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	cases := []map[string]any{}
	consumed := 0
	for _, q := range []string{`{}`, `{resource.service.name="worker"}`, `{resource.service.name="gateway" && span.parity="even"}`, `{span.parity="odd"}`, `{span.parity=~"ev.*"}`, `{span.absent="no"}`} {
		raw := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
		fetch := traceql.NewTagValuesFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, r traceql.FetchTagValuesRequest, cb traceql.FetchTagValuesCallback) error {
			return block.FetchTagValues(ctx, r, cb, func(uint64) {}, opts)
		})
		if e = engine.ExecuteTagValues(context.Background(), tag, q, traceql.MakeCollectTagValueFunc(func(v tempopb.TagValue) bool { raw[v] = true; return false }), fetch); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		found, e := engine.ExecuteSearch(context.Background(), &tempopb.SearchRequest{Query: q + " with (most_recent=true)", Limit: 1000, SpansPerSpanSet: 1000}, traceql.NewSpansetFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, r traceql.FetchSpansRequest) (traceql.FetchSpansResponse, error) {
			return block.Fetch(ctx, r, opts)
		}))
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		selected := map[string]bool{}
		for _, tr := range found.Traces {
			if tr.SpanSet.Matched != uint32(len(tr.SpanSet.Spans)) {
				t.Fatal("clipped fixture")
			}
			selected[tr.TraceID] = true
		}
		type bounds struct{ start, end uint64 }
		groups := map[string]bounds{}
		for _, owner := range all.ResourceSpans {
			sp := owner.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0]
			key := util.TraceIDToHexString(sp.TraceId)
			if !selected[key] {
				continue
			}
			b, ok := groups[key]
			if !ok || sp.StartTimeUnixNano < b.start {
				b.start = sp.StartTimeUnixNano
			}
			if sp.EndTimeUnixNano > b.end {
				b.end = sp.EndTimeUnixNano
			}
			groups[key] = b
		}
		complete := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
		for _, b := range groups {
			typ, value := "int", fmt.Sprint(b.end-b.start)
			if q != "{}" {
				typ, value = "duration", time.Duration(b.end-b.start).String()
			}
			complete[tempopb.TagValue{Type: typ, Value: value}] = true
		}
		sorted := func(set map[tempopb.TagValue]bool) []*tempopb.TagValue {
			out := []*tempopb.TagValue{}
			for v := range set {
				v := v
				out = append(out, &v)
			}
			sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Value < out[j].Value })
			return out
		}
		values := sorted(complete)
		cases = append(cases, map[string]any{"target": target, "query": q, "raw": map[string]any{"tagValues": sorted(raw)}, "complete": map[string]any{"tagValues": values}})
		for _, version := range []int{1, 2} {
			path := fmt.Sprintf("%s/value-%02d-v%d.protobuf", dir, len(cases)-1, version)
			b, e := os.ReadFile(path)
			if os.IsNotExist(e) && os.Getenv("PULSE_REQUIRE_CONSUMER") != "1" {
				continue
			}
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			if version == 2 {
				got := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
				if e = proto.Unmarshal(b, got); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				if !proto.Equal(got, &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{TagValues: values}) {
					t.Fatal("v2 mismatch")
				}
			} else {
				got := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesResponse{}
				if e = proto.Unmarshal(b, got); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				want := []string{}
				for _, v := range values {
					want = append(want, v.Value)
				}
				if !proto.Equal(got, &tempopb.SearchTagValuesResponse{TagValues: want}) {
					t.Fatal("v1 mismatch")
				}
			}
			consumed++
		}
	}
	body, e := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(dir+"/oracle.json", append(body, '\n'), 0644); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	t.Logf("%d actual public consumer messages", consumed)
}
